newsitem.title: MEXICO: Saint-Gobain Mexico plant to open in June.
newsitem.headline: Saint-Gobain Mexico plant to open in June.

text.p: The glass plant of Saint-Gobain de Mexico, a division of French glass firm Saint-Gobain, will begin operations in June 1997, the company said in a news conference late Thursday.
Located 50 km (31 miles) south of Mexico City in the Cuautla, Morelos state, industrial park, the plant cost about $150 million to build, Saint-Gobain director general Jean Louis Beffa said.
"The plant will have a daily production level of 600 tonnes of glass, and will employ about 350 people," he said.
Saint-Gobain has been in Mexico since 1952 under the name Mexalit Industrial. The company stands to compete with Mexican glassmaker Vitro SA.
